topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't believe this is happening! Like, my car, it was right there in the driveway, where it's always been, and now it's just gone. I'm standing here, looking at where it should be, and it's like a piece of the world is missing. I don't understand, how can they just tow it? I mean, it’s my driveway, right? I need this car, I have so much to do. I’ve got to get it back, but how? Where even do I start? This is such a mess. I just want to fix it, make it all okay again.
